PushSubscription.description:
A browser the daemon pushes to, as clients see it: never its endpoint
or keys.

id.description: Eight lowercase letters and digits, assigned by the daemon.

last_error.description: Why the last send failed, until one succeeds.

push_service.description:
The host of the push service the endpoint points at, such as
`fcm.googleapis.com`.

enabled.description: Whether the daemon sends pushes: `[notifications] enabled`.

public_key.description:
The daemon's VAPID public key, an uncompressed P-256 point in
base64url: the `applicationServerKey` browsers subscribe with.
